short_description: Your GitHub contributions by day, week, month and year, over the contribution graph. No token, no computer.
description:
Your GitHub contributions on the BUSY Bar. Press **Start** or **OK** to switch between day, week, month and year; turn the Scroll Wheel to go back in time. The back screen shows your stats.

**Setup:** in the bar's web interface open **Apps → GitHub Activity** and paste your profile link. No token needed.
